title: Yellow Spicy Croatian Shrimp Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy Croatian dish featuring shrimp, kimchi, and cheese, served on a hot stone plate. This jain-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
In a bowl, mix together the kimchi, feta cheese, paprika, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the shrimp, making sure they are fully coated.
Place the skewers on a hot stone plate and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the shrimp are pink and fully cooked.
Serve the shrimp hot, garnished with additional parsley and kimchi if desired.
Make sure to handle the hot stone plate with care, as it will be extremely hot.
Let the shrimp rest for a few minutes before serving, to allow the juices to redistribute.
